videos.title: We Took $10,000 From @mkbhd's Locked iPhone
videos.author: Veritasium
videos.description:
There's a flaw in some virtual wallets.

We exploited this flaw to steal $10,000 from @mkbhd.

Watch the full video to find out how we did it...

videos.title: It's impossible to choose a number at random
videos.author: Veritasium
videos.description:
In math you can't truly pick things at random because formulas always give the same result.

So if we can't pick randomly, how do we select anything in math?

videos.title: Could identical twins commit the perfect crime?
videos.author: Veritasium
videos.description:
The DNA in twins is (almost) exactly the same. 

So how could a team of forensic scientists tell which twin committed the crime?

There is a way but it has some issues...

videos.title: How do submarines know where they are?
videos.author: Veritasium
videos.description:
How does a submarine find its way 600m deep in the ocean?

Surfacing is obviously the easiest way but not when you want to stay hidden.

So how do a crew balance concealment and pathfinding?
